title: Jehoiakim Burns the Scroll

questions.question: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, what did the Lord tell Jeremiah to take and write on?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:2 (ESV): "Take a scroll and write on it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel and Judah and all the nations,"

questions.question: Who did Jeremiah call to write the words of the Lord on the scroll as Jeremiah dictated them?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:4 (ESV): "Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord that he had spoken to him."

questions.question: Why did Jeremiah tell Baruch to go to the house of the Lord and read the scroll to the people?
options: "I am debarred from going to the house of the Lord."
"The people will not listen to me anymore."
"The priests have threatened to kill me."
questions.correctAnswer: "I am debarred from going to the house of the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:5 (ESV): "And Jeremiah ordered Baruch, saying, 'I am debarred from going to the house of the Lord,'"

questions.question: On what specific day was Baruch instructed to read the scroll in the hearing of all the people in the Lord's house?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:6 (ESV): "so you are to go, and on a day of fasting in the hearing of all the people in the Lord's house you shall read the words of the Lord from the scroll that you have written at my dictation."

questions.question: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim, a fast was proclaimed. Where did Baruch read the words of Jeremiah?
options: In the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the secretary
questions.correctAnswer: In the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the secretary
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:10 (ESV): "Then, in the hearing of all the people, Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the scroll, in the house of the Lord, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the secretary,"

questions.question: Who heard Baruch reading the words of the Lord from the scroll and went down to the king's house to tell the officials?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:11-13 (ESV): "When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the scroll, he went down to the king's house, into the secretary's chamber, and all the officials were sitting there..."

questions.question: When the officials sent Jehudi to bring Baruch to them so he could read the scroll to them, how did they react after hearing all the words?
options: They turned to one another in fear
They mocked and laughed at Baruch
They tore their clothes in repentance
questions.correctAnswer: They turned to one another in fear
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:16 (ESV): "When they heard all the words, they turned one to another in fear, and said to Baruch, 'We must report all these words to the king.'"

questions.question: What advice did the officials give to Baruch before they went to tell the king about the scroll?
options: "Go and hide, you and Jeremiah, and let no one know where you are."
"Plead with the king for your lives."
"Burn the scroll before he sees it."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go and hide, you and Jeremiah, and let no one know where you are."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:19 (ESV): "Then the officials said to Baruch, 'Go and hide, you and Jeremiah, and let no one know where you are.'"

questions.question: Where had King Jehoiakim been sitting when Jehudi read the scroll to him? (It was the ninth month).
options: On the roof of the palace
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:22 (ESV): "It was the ninth month, and the king was sitting in the winter house, and there was a fire burning in the fire pot before him."

questions.question: What did King Jehoiakim do as Jehudi read three or four columns of the scroll?
options: He cut them off with a scribe's knife and threw them into the fire pot
He wept and tore his clothes
He tore the scroll in half and trampled it
He ordered his guards to burn it in the courtyard
questions.correctAnswer: He cut them off with a scribe's knife and threw them into the fire pot
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:23 (ESV): "As Jehudi read three or four columns, the king would cut them off with a scribe's knife and throw them into the fire in the fire pot, until the entire scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the fire pot."

questions.question: Who urged the king NOT to burn the scroll, though he would not listen to them?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:25 (ESV): "Even when Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them."

questions.question: When the king commanded his men to seize Baruch and Jeremiah, why couldn't they find them?
options: They were hiding in a cave by the Dead Sea

questions.question: After the king had burned the scroll, what did the Lord tell Jeremiah to do?
options: "Take another scroll and write on it all the former words that were in the first scroll,"
"Go to the king and pronounce a curse on him."
"Stop prophesying and wait for the end."
questions.correctAnswer: "Take another scroll and write on it all the former words that were in the first scroll,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:28 (ESV): "Take another scroll and write on it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned."

questions.question: What judgment did the Lord pronounce upon Jehoiakim king of Judah for burning the scroll?
options: "He shall have none to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be cast out..."
"He shall be taken in chains to Babylon."
"Fire will come down from heaven on his palace."
questions.correctAnswer: "He shall have none to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be cast out..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:30 (ESV): "He shall have none to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be cast out to the heat by day and the frost by night."

questions.question: When Baruch wrote the words on the second scroll from Jeremiah's dictation, what else was added?
options: Many similar words were added to them
A list of names of all who would die in the famine
The date of the city's fall
questions.correctAnswer: Many similar words were added to them
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 36:32 (ESV): "And many similar words were added to them."

key_verse_text: As Jehudi read three or four columns, the king would cut them off with a scribe's knife and throw them into the fire in the fire pot... Yet neither the king nor any of his servants who heard all these words was afraid, nor did they tear their garments.
